text_block_list.text:
Марузенски is training for the next race,
the
Osaka Hai, when Симболи Рудольф
approaches her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After praising Марузенски for setting a
great
example for the younger students,
she expresses
her genuine wish to
compete with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When "Emperor" Симболи Рудольф asks to
face her,
Марузенски is filled with
anticipation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Симболи Рудольф enters
the
Osaka Hai to square off against
Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
